silhouette.reason: Massif and valley read and the rim no longer rolls down; the big right cone is now inside the tile with a snow cap, but it is still one smooth mass, and where the right cut crosses its ridge the skirt top shows thin knife teeth at the corner (hero.png).
fixes: erode the right cone into ridges and couloirs
shift the window or soften the ridge where the right/back cut crosses it so the corner does not end in two thin teeth

proportions.reason: The right cone is too steep and uniform for its height.
fixes: limit max slope to ~60° outside cliff cells

materials.reason: Blended rock, grass, forest and snow; the grey TOP frame is gone and the cone now carries a snow cap that reads in hero.png and TOP, but the cap shows faint contour-line banding, the cone has no rock strata, and the cut walls carry fine vertical streaks in hero.png (the strata texture stretched down the wall).
fixes: rock strata bands on the steep faces of the cone
remove the contour banding in the snow cap (smooth the cover map or add break-up noise)
map the skirt strata in planar U along the wall and V by height so it stops streaking vertically

detail.reason: Forest in the valley and a stream in TOP; the big slopes are smooth.
fixes: more erosion iterations on the smooth slopes

wear.reason: A stream line along the valley floor and forest; little weathering on the rock.
fixes: dark streaks below drainage lines on the cone

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 now keeps the snow line and forest edge as soft blocks instead of blocky white squares; the faces still show faceted diamond shading.
fixes: smooth the LOD2 normals so the faceted diamonds do not show at the switch

technical.reason: One draw, ~137k / 37k / 3.5k triangles for a 2 km tile with a skirt; QA clean. The edge calming is gone: the tile edge is the untouched field, TOP shows no frame and the skirt top follows the border row without a step, so neighbours cut from the same field meet flush.
fixes: drop skirt triangles that are never seen from above (the skirt is a flat wall at every LOD)
